data.name: Storm Burst
data.description: As a standard action, you can create a storm burst targeting any foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. The storm burst deals 1d6 points of nonlethal damage. In addition, the target is buffeted by winds and rain, causing it to take a -2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 round. You can use this ability %2 times per day|StormBurstTimes|PREVARLT:DomainWeatherLVL,2
